title: Automatic OPTIONS logic inverted
detail: The code adds the OPTIONS method when provide_automatic_options is False, which is the opposite of the intended behavior. It should add OPTIONS only when provide_automatic_options is True.
note: Says the condition is inverted: OPTIONS is added when the setting is off.

title: Disabled plugins check crashes on None
detail: When PYDANTIC_DISABLE_PLUGINS is not set, disabled_plugins is None. The condition `disabled_plugins is None and entry_point.name in disabled_plugins.split(',')` attempts to call split on None, raising an AttributeError and preventing any plugins from loading.
note: Names the planted `is None` and the `None.split` it leads to.

title: Selection logic ignores removal of one widget
detail: The code only returns when both widgets are detached, but if either widget is removed the selection should be cleared. This causes stale selections after a widget is removed.
note: Describes the planted `and`: it returns only when both widgets are detached.

title: Zero-width joiner skips next character
detail: The loop increments `index` twice for a ZWJ: once here and once at the end of the loop, causing the following character to be skipped and miscounted.
